evidence_only_guard: Hebrew morphology, Masoretic accents and vocalization, wordplay, repeated roots, discourse formulae, speaker shifts, qere/ketiv, WEB rendering, ancient-version differences, and internal biblical reuse are boundary evidence only. They do not select a preferred reading, witness, versification, speaker, referent, etymology, identity, date, history, fulfillment, canon, authorship, source stratum, ethics, or theology. Roots are not meanings; agreement is evidence, never authority.
macro_parent_alternatives: Hos.1.1-Hos.3.5 superscription plus two sign-act cycles and the reversal/restoration oracle between them.
Hos.4.1-Hos.6.3 controversy, priest/people indictment, alarm, withdrawal, and quoted return response.
Hos.6.4-Hos.8.14 divine reply and successive indictments of breach, palace disorder, foreign alliances, kings, idols, and cult.
Hos.9.1-Hos.11.11 festival/exile warning, historical recollections, and parental-love/compassion movement.
Hos.11.12-Hos.13.16 Ephraim/Judah accusation, Jacob and exodus recollections, kingship failure, death imagery, and Samaria judgment.
Hos.14.1-Hos.14.8 return liturgy and healing/fertility response.
Hos.14.9 wisdom-style epilogue to the whole book.
Hos.1.10-Hos.2.1 is one reversal oracle despite English/Hebrew numbering displacement.
Hos.11.12-Hos.12.1 is one transition unit despite English/Hebrew numbering displacement.

global_holds.versification: English numbering diverges from Hebrew around Hos.1.10-Hos.2.1 and Hos.11.12 onward. Repository coordinates remain controlling; no versification is superior.
global_holds.witnesses: MT/OSHB/UXLC and ancient versions expose seams or uncertainty but establish no preferred text or reconstructed edition.
global_holds.speakers: Uncertain shifts among Yahweh, prophet, people, mother/wife, Ephraim, and quoted voices remain held.
global_holds.wordplay: Names and roots such as Jezreel, Lo-Ruhamah, Lo-Ammi, aqav, sarah, kena'an, Ephraim, and peri are local rhetoric, not exhaustive meanings.
global_holds.internal_relations: Exodus, wilderness, Jacob, Bethel, Gibeah, Baal Peor, Admah/Zeboiim, David, and later reuse are relation evidence only.
global_holds.ethics_and_theology: Marriage, prostitution, childbirth, violence, sacrifice, kingship, death, compassion, covenant, and restoration are literary content, not adjudications.
